about: Real v2 face records (face_geometry.js's classifier over data/meshes, rounded to 6 places) for apps/annotate/run_tests.cjs's opposite-pattern checks: the side Jeff bound and, on the other part, every cylinder coaxial with a bound hole plus like-sized ones that are not.
